# apple_app_clip_default_experience_localization (Resource)

Sets the subtitle of a default App Clip experience for one locale; `apple_app_clip_header_image` adds the locale's image. Provide a localization for the app's primary locale, and the same locales as the app. It can't change once the experience's App Store version is released. Destroying the resource deletes the localization with its header image. Import it by ID or with `<default_experience_id>/<locale>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_app_clip_default_experience_localization" "en_US" {
  default_experience_id = apple_app_clip_default_experience.card.id
  locale                = "en-US"
  subtitle              = "Order ahead and skip the line."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `default_experience_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the default experience, e.g. `apple_app_clip_default_experience.example.id`. Changing it creates a new localization.
- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`. Changing it creates a new localization.

### Optional

- `subtitle` (String) Subtitle shown on the App Clip card.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_app_clip_default_experience_localization.en_US
  identity = {
    id = "6a8c0e2b-3d5f-4b7a-8c9e-1f2a3b4c5d6e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the localization.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <id> or <default_experience_id>/<locale>
terraform import apple_app_clip_default_experience_localization.en_US 2f4b6d8a-1c3e-4a5b-9d7f-0e1a2b3c4d5e/en-US
```
